name: 10123 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10123 (New York) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 10123 (New York) has 12 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

observations.text: 13 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
